claims.text: Object detection isolated 12 discrete new construction and port infrastructure developments (gantry cranes, logistics warehouses, container terminals, elevated freeway viaducts) across Mazgaon and Byculla.
Optical Built-up (NDBI > 0.05) covers 1,933.2 hectares of S2B_MSIL2A_20260312T053639_R005_T43QBB_20260312T092622: 18.4% of the 10,510.2 hectares observed, in 5,143 regions.
The largest contiguous region covers 401.1 hectares, with a mean Built-up of 0.14.
Optical Water (MNDWI > 0.15) covers 4,812.2 hectares of S2B_MSIL2A_20260312T053639_R005_T43QBB_20260312T092622: 45.8% of the 10,510.2 hectares observed, in 197 regions.
The largest contiguous region covers 4,502.7 hectares, with a mean Water of 0.69.
Radar Built-up (VV >= -8 dB and VH >= -15 dB) covers 4,750.9 hectares of S1A_IW_GRDH_1SDV_20260315T010312_20260315T010337_063631_07FF87_rtc: 45.2% of the 10,519.2 hectares observed, in 199 regions.
The largest contiguous region covers 4,669.7 hectares, with a mean Built-up of -2.27.
Radar Water (VV <= -17 dB and VH <= -22 dB) covers 1,694.2 hectares of S1A_IW_GRDH_1SDV_20260315T010312_20260315T010337_063631_07FF87_rtc: 16.1% of the 10,519.2 hectares observed, in 2,028 regions.
The largest contiguous region covers 523.3 hectares, with a mean Water of -19.33.
Intertidal sediment moisture and groundwater saturation delineate 104.7 ha of dynamic tidal mudflat across Sewri and Mahim Bay, explaining the optical-radar physical backscatter anomaly.
Coastal mangrove canopy along the Sewri intertidal boundary and Byculla urban canopy cover 109.6 ha with moderate to high photosynthetic vigour (NDVI 0.28 to 0.52).
